description: Morphology-neutral residual-to-physics-question bridge: inverse-by-forward-model kinematic prior, relation-shape analogy, verified analysis-by-synthesis trajectories, six-axis integer Pareto experiments, curiosity collapse, and receipt closure.

rules.name: epm_open_physics_question_from_learning_residual
rules.comment: A failed learning policy becomes a body-relative physics question. The horizon is derived from known transitions and relational prerequisite depth, never an authored retry count.

rules.name: epm_retrieve_motor_stage_by_relation_shape
rules.comment: Plan stages are explanatory analogies only. Partial relation overlap is retained as a basin hint; it cannot actuate.

rules.name: epm_retrieve_verified_proposal_shape_across_similar_body
rules.comment: A successful experiment is reusable only as an output-null basin hint. Both desired consequence topology and the currently observed body relation system must overlap; the local body must still verify it physically.

rules.name: epm_mint_complete_integer_proposal_from_verified_path
rules.comment: Receipt-verified analysis-by-synthesis paths become complete six-coordinate experiments. Energy and load remain separate objectives; no reward scalar is invented.

rules.name: epm_publish_unseen_compound_as_integer_pareto_proposal
rules.comment: A domain adapter may publish an output-null compound assembled from receipt-learned primitives. Its forward projection is a testable prediction, never confused with physical verification.

rules.name: epm_curiosity_selects_one_pareto_motor_experiment
rules.comment: The massively parallel proposal frontier collapses to one compound experiment. This is still output-null: the existing motor collapse retains sole actuator authority.

rules.name: epm_curiosity_selects_one_unseen_compound_experiment
rules.comment: Selection remains output-null. The body adapter must route the chosen compound through its ordinary motor and material envelope collapse before any effector receives authority.
